At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose.
Position Overview
Are you interested in using your software engineering skills to build numerical systems that enable machine learning and analytics on large data sets? Financial Engineering is seeking a Software Engineer Professional to develop production systems that involve data science and machine learning. We are looking for a creative and talented individual who loves to code. Apply now and learn why there’s #MoreAtFreddieMac!
Our impact

  * We partner with the Single-Family Collateral Modeling team which is responsible for the firm’s Automated Valuation Model
  * We build systems to make their models, data, and analytics available for business use
  * We ensure that our systems are robust, scalable and fault-tolerant
Your impact

  * Implement new models and data transformations using Python based technologies such as PySpark and Pandas
  * Implement and expose model as web service API using Flask and deploy web services to AWS EKS
  * Optimize Python code to reduce runtime and memory usage
  * Write high quality automated tests to validate your code
  * Peer review other team member’s code and help them with design and implementation challenges
Qualifications

  * At least 2-4 years of experience developing in Python
  * Master's degree in Computer Science, Computational Finance or a directly related quantitative field.
  * Experience building production systems for business-critical processes
  * Experience with building and integrating tools, including knowledge of Gradle, Jenkins, Git and Docker.
  * Experience developing with large microservice based architectures, container orchestration frameworks.
  * Demonstrated experience with relational databases including MSSQL, MySQL
  * Experience writing automated unit, integration, regression, performance and acceptance tests
  * Solid understanding of software design principles
Keys to Success in this Role

  * Passionate about hands-on software development
  * Strong collaboration and communication skills (both written and verbal), including interacting with data scientists on technical topics
  * Desire to continuously improve the technical quality and architecture of our systems to respond to business needs
  * Ability to quickly learn, apply and deploy new technologies to solve emerging problems

# Associate, Mortgage Analytics

#### 

National Life Group Montpelier, VT

Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.
Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.
We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. The flat and collaborative nature of our team promotes an atmosphere where the best ideas are continually expressed and rewarded. Our pursuit of excellence is unwavering.
Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.
Role Summary
The Associate, Mortgage Analytics is responsible for residential whole loan and RMBS analytics used for trading, portfolio management, asset management, and servicing oversight. This is a hands-on role supporting a rapidly growing $5bn+ AUM residential mortgage platform spanning residential whole loans and RMBS.
The Associate works closely with analysts, traders, portfolio managers, and the Investment Committee, who rely on the role’s analytical output to drive the decision process. The successful candidate is fluent in residential mortgage risk, prepayment analytics, loan credit characteristics, and the plumbing of the mortgage market, including how loans are originated, packaged, sold, and serviced.
This is a technical role requiring fluency in Python, SQL, and a data platform such as Databricks.
This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days. Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  * Build and maintain the models used to price residential whole loans and RMBS and run their cash flows, updating assumptions as rates and borrower behavior change.
  * Crack and clean bid tapes and loan-level data, price pools, and prepare memos for Transaction Committees overseeing whole loan trading activity.
  * Evaluate securitization vs. whole loan markets, and quantify both prepayment and credit risk.
  * Evaluate portfolio data and develop repeatable institutional analytics tracking portfolio performance.
  * Model prepay and default behavior, develop market comparables and benchmarks, and present performance data to portfolio managers and Investment Committee.
  * Support servicing oversight by converting raw servicing data into clear takeaways on servicer performance and loan-level exceptions.
  * Own the data pipelines and tooling behind the analytics, including Databricks, Python, and SQL, with a focus on continual improvement.
  * Reconcile loan data across systems and work with Operations and Transaction Management to resolve.
  * Provide ad hoc analysis and support for trading and portfolio management functions.
  * All other duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualifications

  * A quantitative degree or equivalent work experience.
  * 2–5 years experience in mortgage analytics or a related field.
  * A strong understanding of mortgage cash flows, prepayment modeling, and pricing of residential mortgage risk in both whole loan and securitized form.
  * Comfortable working with servicing and remittance data.
  * Strong Python and SQL skills and experience, plus hands-on work in Databricks or a similar platform.
  * A solid grasp of mortgage analytics and prepayment modeling systems (Aladdin, Intex, Bloomberg, etc.).
The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances.
Additional Compensation and Benefits. The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in National Life’s discretionary annual incentive programs, subject to the rules governing such programs. If hired, the employee will be in an "at-will position" and National Life reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.
National Life is accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis and the role remains open until filled.

## About the job

C3 AI is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer, Federal (On-Site) to join our Federal team. In this role, you will be the on-site engineer responsible for a C3 AI Platform deployment running in a disconnected, on-premises environment at a secure government facility in Southern Maryland. Your primary focus is keeping the system available: monitoring its health, responding to incidents and outages, performing upgrades and patches, and building the automation and runbooks that keep problems from recurring. When operations are steady, you will support the customer’s applications on the platform through troubleshooting and evaluating potential enhancements. An ideal candidate is calm under pressure, comfortable debugging Linux and Kubernetes without internet access, and able to work directly with federal customers. This role requires U.S. citizenship, an active Secret clearance, and the ability to obtain additional program access. Responsibilities

  * Operate and maintain the C3 AI Platform in the customer's disconnected, on-premises environment, maximizing uptime.
  * Respond to incidents and outages: diagnose root cause, restore service, and document findings.
  * Monitor system health and build alerting and automation to prevent recurrence.
  * Plan and perform upgrades and patches using offline artifacts.
  * When operations are steady, contribute to application development and enhancements, using your on-site proximity to the customer to gather feedback, understand use cases, and translate needs into requirements.
  * Surface technical risks and work with product, engineering, and SRE teams to improve product quality.
  * Occasionally travel to visit C3 AI offices or other customer sites. Qualifications
  * Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field or equivalent professional experience.
  * Software development experience with JavaScript and Python.
  * Experience with scripting or programming (Python or Bash preferred) to automate and monitor systems.
  * Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.
  * Experience working in a customer-facing role. Preferred qualifications
  * Demonstrated experience in deploying, managing, and operating scalable and fault-tolerant Kubernetes-based infrastructure, especially on-prem.
  * Expertise in Linux operating systems, networking, and database concepts.
  * Experience with Git or other version control software.
  * 2+ years of professional software development experience with object-oriented programming languages.

Security and work environment

  * This role is performed full time on-site in a secure government facility.
  * Requires U.S. citizenship, an active Secret clearance, and the ability to obtain additional program access.
  * Program access involves an enhanced security review, which may include review of foreign contacts, foreign travel, and finances. Ongoing reporting obligations apply.
  * Program access is expected to take 3-6 months. During this time, training will be conducted, including regular travel to our Tysons, VA office. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.
